facts.statement: e-Gov records the amendment as in_force (in_force_instrument) as of the evidence date.
Provisions changed (e-Gov old/new text): 第15条, 第18条

Articles 15 and 18 now expressly allow a resident record showing nationality etc. for a person without Japanese nationality, instead of only referring to a resident record showing registered domicile. Article 15 retains mandatory submission of application and supporting documents; Article 18 retains optional application for replacement after changes.

Applicants for septic-tank manager certificates under Article 15, and existing certificate holders seeking replacement following a change in recorded particulars under Article 18, including non-Japanese nationals.

Article 15 continues to require submission of the specified application and supporting documents to the Environment Minister; Article 18 permits, but does not require, an application for replacement when certificate particulars change.
Supplementary provisions paragraph 2 deems existing documents in old forms compliant with the amended forms; paragraph 3 allows remaining old-form paper to be adapted and used for the time being.

The ministerial regulation prescribes application documentation pursuant to Septic Tank Act Article 45(1); the amendments concern the evidentiary documentation in Articles 15 and 18, not a new general delegation of powers.

The express nationality-record alternative appears intended to clarify document submission for applicants without Japanese nationality; a specific ministry policy rationale has not yet been independently established.

Certificate applicants and organizations assisting them should check that the resident record contains the appropriate nationality particulars, and that old forms are handled under the supplementary provisions.
